question: Which calendrical and ritual occasions are suitable for performing the bathing?
premises: The bathing may be done at a solstice
It may be done at an equinox
It may be done at an eclipse, installation, and similar occasions
inference: Solstices, equinoxes, eclipses, and installations are suitable occasions for the bathing
plain_english: It may also be performed at a solstice, at an equinox, or during an eclipse, installation, and similar occasions.
